<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import MyIcon from "./MyIcon.vue";

defineArt("./MyButton.vue", { title: "MyButton", category: "Base" });

const count = ref(0);
</script>

<art>
  <variant name="Default" default>
    <MyButton @click="count++">Clicked {{ count }}</MyButton>
  </variant>

  <variant name="WithIcon">
    <MyButton><MyIcon /> Icon</MyButton>
  </variant>
</art>
